name: gizza-ai/gif-resize
summary: Resize an animated GIF to new dimensions

tool.description: Resize an animated GIF to new pixel dimensions, preserving every frame, its timing, and the loop. Provide width and/or height; if only one is given the other is computed to preserve the aspect ratio. Returns the resized GIF. Provide the GIF as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref from a prior tool call.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

width.description: Target width in pixels. Omit to compute from height, preserving aspect ratio.

height.description: Target height in pixels. Omit to compute from width, preserving aspect ratio.
